data.content_ref: inline:SRC_004 contradicts SRC_005 because OOD adversarial probes and error-shape analysis are rival, mutually exclusive single-evaluation discriminators: if adversarial items are required, the panel's error variance on natural-distribution items is confounded by the same surface-proxy alignment, so the error-shape signal cannot be read off the natural distribution; it is refuted if a single evaluation can contain both adversarial items and enough natural items to estimate error variance, making the two signals complementary rather than contradictory.
